sloka: मानुषान्न गणे देव स्वल्पास्ते मम सम्मताः ।दीर्घमायुश्च मे प्राप्तं ब्रह्मणस्त्रिपुरान्तक ।। ७.१६.४३ ॥
transliteration: mānuṣānna gaṇe deva svalpāste mama sammatāḥ ।dīrghamāyuśca me prāptaṁ brahmaṇastripurāntaka ।। 7.16.43 ॥

translations.english: O god, I do not count humans, as they are considered insignificant by me; and O destroyer of Tripura, I have already obtained a long life from Brahma.
